verdict.rationale: No OpenAPI document was found: every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The only machine-readable spec-equivalent in the pack is a community mention that LiveKit maintains a separate Protocol project of protobuf message definitions, used as a reference for what is under the hood. missing for 10: a published, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec for the server APIs, first-party docs pointing to the protobuf/Twirp definitions as the API contract, and confirmation that the protobuf definitions cover the full server API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Appreciated that LiveKit keeps a separate Protocol project (protobuf messages). It gives a quick sense of what's under the hood and serves as a helpful reference.
